_readme: Which checks cover which files. Built by scripts/buildCheckMap.mjs from what each check imports and names; edit serial, ignore, engine and notes by hand, the builder keeps them. Run: node scripts/runChecks.mjs

notes.clock: expiredRowServedCheck and questionColdCheck fail between 00:00 and 03:00 UTC (a row 2 to 3 hours old is then from the earlier UTC day); that is the clock, not running beside other checks
notes.origin_main: tasksBadgeCheck and tasksCrewExportCheck copy api/tasks.js from origin/main (git show) into a temporary file next to this worktree's lib; when origin/main moves ahead of the worktree they fail on an import the worktree does not have. Run them on a tree rebased on origin/main.
notes.unstable: searchCheck and reasonWordsCheck give different counts between runs even one at a time (searchCheck 3 pass 0 fail exit 1 serial, 10 pass beside others; reasonWordsCheck 882/3, 748/2, 175/0 in different runs): they depend on something the runner does not control (network, the archive or the order of an object). Not an effect of running side by side.

coldResolverCheck.serial: asserts how many milliseconds a primed first car waits for the outside list (205 ms against a limit); it fails when other checks take the processor (3.1 s alone, 5.1 s beside others)

crewWiringCheck.serial: browser checks that count how many times an action ran or wait for a rendered state; they fail about one run in three when seven checks share the processor (valueIntentCheck: 'the action completes exactly once (opens 2)'), and pass alone

deskCompsMinCheck.serial: writes temporary mutant copies of lib, api and scripts files (names like __xxmut_*) into the repo tree while it runs, and some edit a real file in place; a check that reads or imports those folders at the same moment sees them (tasksCrewLimitCheck broke reasonWordsCheck, searchCheck and tierBandPoolCheck this way)
